paper.title: Metabolomic machine learning predictor for diagnosis and prognosis of gastric cancer

findings.evidence: The paper reports "95% confidence" intervals, but the code computes the interval with 5%/95% bounds (`confidence_lower = sorted_scores[int(0.05 * len(sorted_scores))]`) (and 3 similar line(s)), which is a 90% interval; no 2.5%/97.5% bounds appear anywhere in the code. Check whether the reported intervals are 90% intervals.
